row.title: SPEND-SOFT-1: 5 USD a day is a soft target with graduated throttling, never a hard stop
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-21: Workers Paid only with cost controls, no more than 5 USD a day, and caps must be soft like a phone plan; a system never grinds to a halt. seed/worker/src/spend.js estimates today's bill from one Cloudflare GraphQL reading (requests, CPU, D1, KV, R2, Durable Objects, account-wide AI neurons) at list prices and sets a band by threshold share of the target: full under 0.5, ease under 0.7 (idle loops x1.5, cheapest model first), throttle under 0.9 (AI inside the free allocation, wide reads hourly, loops x3), crawl above (essential steps and dispatch/execute every tick, the rest every 3 h, AI one call per tick from the free allocation). The AI governor has no frozen mode: past its allowance it crawls at one call an hour. Lean and degrade no longer skip steps for good (tick.js stepPlan). Per-tenant shares in instances/ultrastable/instance.json spend.tenants. Cloudflare billing email alerts at 75 and 150 USD a month were added beside the auto-created 10 USD one; the native Workers spending limit is deliberately not set because it blocks every Worker.

title: SPEND-SOFT-1: 5 USD a day is a soft target with graduated throttling, never a hard stop
